title: cartrema marginata var. longissima
intro: Cartrema marginata var. longissima, commonly known as "Long-stemmed Cartrema," is a plant species that belongs to the Cartrema genus within the Rutaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cartrema marginata var. longissima are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
